Absolutely incredible expertise. We received a recommendation for euthanasia for our own dog in the fall. It was a 9-month-old Pyrenean Mastiff whose lameness was resolved by several orthopedists. After the euthanasia recommendation, we decided to try surgery, where the outcome was uncertain. However, before the surgery, we received a recommendation to visit Talvio. Since it was a long way from Kuopio, we started communicating by email, to which Timo kindly replied during the weekend. He recommended a quick visit to the reception.

In the courtyard of the Punavuore clinic, we still wondered if this was a useless visit? Inside, Talvio came to say hello, holding his hand, and we took the lame dog into the courtyard for a moment. So only a few seconds were enough, after which he examined the dog. From that visit, I finally remembered one sentence Timo said to his crying wife when she asked him what are you doing now? Timo replied that now I will take care of your dog's knee. And that is what he did. The massive inflammation caused by the growth disorder (this was not noticed elsewhere) was resolved, the cysts on the bone surface healed and the bone was grown with the help of PRP treatment.

We drove south five times. Once to Punavuori and three times to Kirkkonummi where Timo has modern facilities and a homely atmosphere. Two PRP treatments later, the dog is a completely different dog and I can now continue the life of a young dog towards adulthood.

Timo and Anne are wonderful people who genuinely care about the well-being of the animal. We drove a total of 5000km for diagnoses and treatments, but it was worth it. Highly recommended!
Unhurried and friendly service. Good care and specialized expertise. No need to drive a long distance.
My dog's teeth were taken care of with no complications. No hassle, no unnecessary examinations, and I was allowed to attend.  This is the best place to go if your pet has any health problem.
Very professional and careful work. Everything went quickly, the atmosphere was excellent. Thank you, it was worth the long drive.
